primary_meaning: A committed learner and follower of Jesus Christ who adheres to His teachings, imitates His way of life, and often incurs personal cost or self-denial
primary_basis: Matthew 4:18-22 (calling of the first disciples to follow)
Matthew 16:24 / Mark 8:34 / Luke 9:23 (take up the cross and follow)
John 8:31 (abiding in Jesus' word as true discipleship)

alternatives.meaning: Specifically the Twelve chosen apostles as a restricted inner circle, distinct from the larger group of followers
basis: John 6:66-71 (distinction between many disciples and the Twelve)

alternatives.meaning: Any pupil or adherent of a religious teacher (rabbinic or general first-century usage), not uniquely Christian or Christ-centered
basis: Matthew 22:16 / Mark 2:18 (disciples of the Pharisees or John the Baptist)

alternatives.meaning: A symbol of the entire Christian community or Church as those who continue Jesus' mission after the resurrection

notes: In mainstream Christian teaching and biblical studies the term carries a clear, non-esoteric primary sense as follower/learner of Jesus; symbolic extensions (cost, imitation, Church) remain secondary and rest on the same core passages. No major competing symbolic system displaces this consensus within published Christian interpretation.
